partnershipPlan: Two patient partners who completed prehabilitation review the information sheet and the demonstration of the bedside tests.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments from the prehabilitation program's exit questionnaires are read for themes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: By the time I had the bike test, my operation was ten days away and there was no time for the exercise classes.
items.implication: Measure how quickly bedside triage could lead to a place.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My knees would not let me stand up and sit down that many times, but my heart and lungs are fine.
items.implication: Record why a test could not be completed and report accuracy by reason.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We all sit in the same office; keeping the results apart will take discipline.
items.implication: Sequence tests so the index test always comes first and store results separately.

summary: Three composite voices on waiting, joint pain and blinding.
